result.summary: The image shows a commercial urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a marked zebra crosswalk. Streetcar tracks are embedded in the roadway, and parked vehicles along the curb may obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for cyclists.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra markings are worn, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crossing area limit sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbsides near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility 'ladder' or 'continental' markings.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and has sightline obstructions due to parked vehicles near the crossing point.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The signalized intersection lacks dedicated pedestrian heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb line may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to clarify right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking at the corner.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by wide sidewalks but lacks essential safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection. The presence of trolley tracks and degraded pavement creates additional hazards for those crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a trip hazard or a risk to cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven roadway surfaces near the intersection increase the risk of trips and falls.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

result.summary: This commercial urban intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and traffic signals, but suffers from maintenance issues and poor sightlines. Pedestrians face hazards from faded crosswalk markings, trolley tracks in the roadway, and a large truck obstructing the view of oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway create a trip hazard and can be slippery for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large box truck parked near the corner blocks sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, parked on the side street

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk paint is heavily worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with continental-style markings to increase visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and prevent parking too close to the intersection, which improves sightlines.

interventions.title: Pavement and Track Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the degraded asphalt and ensure the area around the trolley tracks is level to minimize trip hazards.
